name: varg-character-absurd
description: Makes absurd AI characters and mascots people share, on varg: hybrids of a food or object, an animal and one human detail (a T-rex made of bread in a beret, a grumpy cactus mail carrier, a nervous sheep accountant), in a 3D family-film, clay stop-motion or photoreal look, as a turnaround sheet ready for scenes and video. The Italian-brainrot format with original characters. Use when someone asks for an absurd, funny, weird or brainrot character, a creature, a talking animal or object, a food character, or a brand mascot. Part of varg-character-design (definition, sheet, reuse in video).
